Hi Helen — appreciate the quick turnaround and congrats on the close.

Attached is a short MAP appendix that embeds the post-signature implementation plan you asked for (MAP_Hippocare_v1.2.pdf). High level summary below so you can copy into the operations briefing:  

- Week 0 (Aug 13–17): Pre-cutover readiness — account provisioning, KMS key exchange, private VPC peering checklist, access control review.
- Week 1 (Aug 20–24): Canary week 1 — 10% traffic routed to Redwood Dedicated pool with detailed metrics collection (latency, error rate, token cost). Training for 6 superusers (ops + app admins) on Aug 22 (2-hour session).
- Week 2 (Aug 27–31): Canary week 2 — expand to 40% traffic if thresholds met; run migration dry-run for bulk-backfill.
- Week 3 (Sep 3–7): Full cutover window (night-by-night slices) with rollback gating; final end-user training and handoff doc published.

Key gating criteria for each canary expansion are explicit in the MAP appendix (latency delta <25ms, error spike <0.5%, golden prompt accuracy within 1.5% of baseline). If any gate fails we revert to previous traffic split and engage fallback plan discussed on page 3.

I've included the following artifacts and owners in the MAP appendix: mutual action checklist, evaluation plan (prompt set and pass/fail thresholds), runbook snippets for canary rollback, and links to the DocuSign contract.

Next steps: if this looks good we propose locking the canary start on Mon Aug 20; Priya will own deployment orchestration and Avery will run training and evals. Please confirm stake-holders you want on the daily canary standup (15 minutes) and which timezone your ops team prefers.

Thanks — Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_Hippocare_v1.2.pdf (PDF, 98KB), hippopostsign_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB)
